# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC, Palm Coast, Florida) is a done-for-you AI operator for funded companies and 30–200 person teams that already pay for software. Main offers: the AI Ad Sprint ($297 one time, or $997/mo for 20 new ads), AI Concierge ($2,000/mo), and consulting at $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250. Deploy Agent, the $1,250 go-live sprint ($625 deposit), is at https://firstdeploy.ai/deploy-agent/. Freight Ops AI Agent, a two-week proof of a custom AI agent for freight brokerages and 3PLs ($2,500 to start through Stripe, scoped per brokerage), is at https://firstdeploy.ai/freight-ops-ai-agent/. Picks (https://agenthiveinc.com/picks/) is the one-page storefront for our Come and Take It gear and the tools and deals we recommend. Call +1 320-335-6186. IndexMe.lol is the honest IndexNow indexing desk at https://indexme.lol.

AgentHive Inc builds to your brand, runs it, and hands you the finished result. Public site: https://agenthiveinc.com. AgentHive Inc · Palm Coast, FL · firstdeploy.ai.

## Offers on First Deploy AI (firstdeploy.ai, same company)
- [Deploy Agent](https://firstdeploy.ai/deploy-agent/): a $1,250 forward-deployed go-live sprint ($625 deposit) that gets a B2B AI product working inside a customer's systems. Measured in days-to-live; no promised timeline.
- [Freight Ops AI Agent](https://firstdeploy.ai/freight-ops-ai-agent/): a $2,500 two-week proof of a custom AI agent for freight brokerages and 3PLs at roughly $10M to $100M, on one workflow such as check calls, track and trace, carrier sales, or load booking. $2,500 to start through Stripe, scoped per brokerage.
- [Buyer questions](https://firstdeploy.ai/questions/): short answers about AI go-live sprints and freight AI agents.
